products.name: Tuga A6
products.tagline: The one that lives in your pocket.
products.shortFor: Photos, job sheets, sign-off and comms, on a phone that survives the site.
products.description: A 6.8 inch rugged Android handheld for tradespeople who need a tough device in their pocket. IP68 and IP69K rated, drop tested to MIL-STD-810H, with a 10600mAh battery and 5G.
products.longDescription: The A6 is the smallest device in the range. It goes in a pocket or a belt holster, shrugs off the kind of drop that cracks an ordinary phone, and still has charge at the end of a long shift. The 64MP night vision camera earns its keep in loft spaces, voids and under floors where a torch and a phone in the same hand is one hand too few. 5G means photos and job sheets upload before you have got back to the van.
highlights: IP68 + IP69K, survives jet washing, not just rain
64MP night vision camera for dark voids and loft spaces
10600mAh battery with 33W fast charging
5G, so uploads finish before you leave the job
products.positioning: The pocket option. Proof of delivery, quick photos, barcode scanning, comms.

products.name: Tuga A8
products.tagline: The all-rounder. Fits the van door pocket.
products.shortFor: Forms, maps, site photos and quotes, one-handed, all shift.
products.description: An 8 inch rugged Android tablet with IP68 protection, 4G LTE and a sunlight readable screen. A middle size: big enough for forms and drawings, small enough to hold in one hand.
products.longDescription: Eight inches is the middle of the three sizes. It is big enough to fill in a form, read a drawing or follow a route without pinching and zooming, and small enough to hold in one hand up a ladder or drop into a van door pocket. Sunlight readable at 800 nits, sealed to IP68, and drop tested to MIL-STD-810H. Vehicle mountable with 4G LTE built in, so it works as a dashboard unit on the road and a site tablet when you get there.
highlights: 800 nit sunlight readable screen you can use on a bright roof
Fits a van door pocket and one hand
10000mAh battery with 4G LTE for remote sites
Vehicle mountable, so it is a dashboard unit and site tablet in one
products.positioning: The all-rounder. The sweet spot between portability and screen space.

products.name: Tuga A10
products.tagline: Full-size. For drawings you actually need to read.
products.shortFor: Blueprints, BIM viewers, full spreadsheets and PDF plans.
products.description: A 10.1 inch Full HD rugged Android tablet for when you need real screen space. IP68 sealed and MIL-STD-810H tested, with 8GB RAM, an 8000mAh battery, NFC and dual SIM 4G in a slim 680g body.
products.longDescription: When the job involves drawings, the 8 inch stops being enough. The A10 gives you a full 10.1 inch Full HD screen for blueprints, BIM viewers, spreadsheets and PDF plans, in a slim 14.5mm body sealed to IP68 and tested to MIL-STD-810H. The 8000mAh battery with quick charge gets you through a full shift, and dual SIM 4G keeps you connected across networks on rural and remote sites. This is the one that lives in a vehicle mount or a site office and gets picked up all day.
highlights: 10.1 inch Full HD screen, so you can read a drawing without pinching and zooming
IP68 and MIL-STD-810H in a slim 14.5mm, 680g body
8GB RAM and 128GB storage, expandable to 2TB
Dual SIM 4G for patchy rural coverage

specs.connectivity: 4G Dual SIM, dual-band Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 5.2, NFC

products.positioning: The site tablet. Blueprints, BIM viewers, full spreadsheets, PDF plans.

products.name: Tuga WH6
products.shortFor: Legacy Windows software and network drives, in a holster.
products.description: A 6.5 inch rugged Windows 11 handheld for professionals who need desktop software on the move. Run legacy apps, access network drives, and manage field data from a device that fits in a holster.
products.longDescription: The WH6 puts full Windows 11 in your pocket. An Intel Celeron N5100, 8GB of RAM and 128GB of storage (plus a microSD slot for more) run the Windows software your industry never moved off, reach network drives, and manage field data without compromise. It is rated IP65 and MIL-STD-810H, survives 1.5 metre drops, and works from -20°C to 60°C. The 4000mAh battery is removable, so a spare keeps you going through a long shift, and 4G LTE, GPS + GLONASS and NFC are on board. USB-A and USB-C ports connect straight to instruments and peripherals. A 2D barcode scanner is available as an option for warehouse and logistics work, and a charging dock is sold separately for desk use.
highlights: Full Windows 11, not a mobile OS pretending
Intel Celeron N5100, 8GB RAM, 128GB storage
Removable 4000mAh battery, so a spare keeps you running
Fits a holster, runs desktop software
Optional integrated 2D barcode scanner

specs.charging: USB-C PD fast charge, pogo pin for dock
specs.connectivity: 4G LTE, dual-band Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 5.0, NFC, GPS + GLONASS
specs.ports: USB-C (OTG), USB-A, microSD, Nano-SIM, pogo pin

products.positioning: Windows in your pocket for professionals who need desktop software on the move.

products.name: Tuga W8
products.shortFor: Windows software in the field, with real ports.
products.description: An 8 inch rugged Windows 11 Pro tablet with an Intel processor, full USB ports and HDMI output. For professionals who need Windows software in the field without giving up durability.
products.longDescription: The W8 puts full Windows 11 Pro in a rugged 8 inch body. An Intel Celeron N5100, 8GB of RAM and a 128GB SSD run your Windows software as they would on a desk. The port selection is the point: USB-C, USB-A and HDMI, so you can connect to whatever the job needs rather than carrying a bag of adapters. Sealed to IP67, with NFC and a pogo pin dock connector for desk mounting. A barcode scanner variant is available.
highlights: Full Windows 11 Pro in an 8 inch rugged body
USB-C, USB-A and HDMI, so no adapter bag
Pogo pin dock connector for desk use
Optional integrated 2D barcode scanner
products.positioning: The 8 inch Windows tablet for professionals who need real software in the field.

products.name: Tuga W10
products.shortFor: Engineers and surveyors who need Ethernet, HDMI and a full screen.
products.description: A 10.1 inch rugged Windows 11 Pro tablet with an Intel N100 processor and a full port selection including RJ45 Ethernet and HDMI. For engineers, surveyors and field professionals who need full desktop capability.
products.longDescription: The W10 is the full desktop experience in a rugged package. An Intel N100 processor (up to 3.4GHz), 8GB of RAM and 128GB of storage run Windows 11 Pro on a 10.1 inch IPS touchscreen. The port selection is what sets it apart: HDMI, RJ45 Ethernet, USB-C and USB-A for direct connections to plant, panels and network gear that has never seen Wi-Fi. Rated IP65 for dust and water jets, with a removable 5000mAh battery, NFC, a microSD slot and a pogo pin dock connector. Options include 4G LTE, GPS, a fingerprint reader, a 2D barcode scanner and a UHF RFID reader.
highlights: RJ45 Ethernet, so you can plug straight into panels and plant
10.1 inch IPS touchscreen, full Windows 11 Pro on an Intel N100
Removable 5000mAh battery, USB-C, USB-A, HDMI and Ethernet on board
Optional 2D barcode scanner and UHF RFID reader

specs.connectivity: Dual-band Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 5.2, NFC, 100Mbps Ethernet, optional 4G LTE

products.positioning: The full desktop experience. Real screen estate, full ports, full Windows.

products.description: The Tuga WH6 with an integrated 2D barcode scanner. Full Windows 11 in a rugged handheld with professional scanning for warehouse, logistics and inventory work.
